name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  April 30, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room
“A” 1st Floor on April 30, 2026, at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley, Deputy City Clerk Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra C. Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Christine Rivera asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Christine Rivera reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Natalia Mendez on behalf of United Way Greater Los Angeles to host a Walk United
  LA 2026 Event at 1001 S Stadium Dr., Private Property, on Saturday, May 09, 2026,
  from 5:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. Approval for a one-day event within the Sofi Stadium
  parking lot. Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way.
  Applicant is responsible for crowd control, event clean-up, and all applicable
  mitigation measures. Applicant to hire adequate SoFi security staff for the safety of
  attendees and to monitor the host beer garden. IPD Watch Commander will be
  notified, and extra patrol will be provided as time permits. Adhere to all local, state,
  and federal laws. *IPD & TCO staffing TBD* Conditions for amplified sound: Manage
  noise reading. Comply with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29. Provide a direct point of contact
  for the person in charge of sound and acoustics volume control; no
  recommendations needed for Fire approval; Motion carried unanimously to pull the
  item from the P&L Agenda (Activity No. 00427109)
 Item #2:  Mark Alford on behalf of Rapha Racing LLC to host a Cookout Ride Event 2026 at
  700 Warren Lane – Edward Vincent Jr. Park; Public Property; on Saturday, May 16,
  2026, from 1:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for a
  one (1) day event at Edward Vincent Park. Subject to Parks and Rec approval for
  use of the park. Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event cleanup. Subject
  to all applicable IMC regulations. Applicant to hire two (2) police officers for public
  safety and six (6) professional-licensed security guards to assist IPD with any
  potential crowd control. Security staff (male & female team) shall also monitor the
  restrooms used by guests/attendees to deter any outside lewd conduct. There are
  NO alcoholic beverages allowed in the park or at this event, which includes the use
  of cannabis (smoking or vaping). This application is subject to Parks & Recreation
  Department approval for use of the facility. Conditions for amplified sound: Manage
  noise reading. Comply with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29. Provide a direct point of contact
  for the person responsible for sound and acoustics volume control. No
  recommendations needed for Fire approval; Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00427055)
New Business License Request (s):

Item #3:  Salvador Castillo, on behalf of Sports Auto, to operate as a Used Car Dealership
  Business at 1149 S. La Brea Ave., Approved Conditionally; Approval for the
  expansion of a used car sales business. Applicant must complete the Parcel Map
  process and record the required parcel map. Subject to all applicable IMC
  Regulations. Approved conditionally; Applicant shall provide valid ID on him/herself
  and ALL employees, including co-applicants (state DMV / Dealer licenses if
  applicable). NO parking of vehicles, vehicle repairs/maintenance of vehicles on city
  streets, sidewalks, or alleys. Violators will be cited & towed at owner's / operator's
  expense. This establishment's DMV & licensing records are subject to random
  inspection at any time by the Inglewood Police Department, Inglewood Code
  Enforcement, and Investigators with the California Department of Motor Vehicles to
  ensure compliance with the laws & conditions set forth by the City of Inglewood
  (Permits & Licenses Committee) and the State of California. Any violation of these
  conditions or of the law may result in the immediate suspension or revocation of any
  city license, leading to the closure of this business establishment. Subject to the
  Planning Department's Approval. Adhere to all local, state, and federal laws; Code
  Enforcement Department; Condition Vehicle inventory not to be parked or stored on
  public right-of-way; No recommendations needed for Fire approval. Motion carried
  unanimously to pull the item from the P&L Agenda (Activity No. 00426949)
Held Over from 4.23.26
Item #4:  Amr Elkurdi on behalf of Mori Market to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 1041 S
  Prairie Ave. Approval for tobacco sales in an existing convenience store. Maximum
  120  square-foot  tobacco  retail  floor  area.  No  marijuana
  sales/distribution/cultivation/etc per IMC regulations. Subject to all applicable IMC
  regulations; Approved conditionally; NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized /
  hookah products) to underage or any persons under 21 years of age. All persons
  purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products SHALL have a valid ID on their
  person at all times to ensure the restriction of underage tobacco use, including
  hookah products. Submit all state tobacco renewal certificates if applicable. ** NO
   sales of single cigarettes (CIGARS OK) and NO loitering of persons in or outside of
  the location. NO LOITERING, NO TRESPASSING, NO PANHANDLING signage to
  be posted outside of the business by the applicant. NO persons under 21 years of
  age are allowed in smoke shops or establishments whose primary business is selling
  tobacco. This is to prevent or discourage minors from being enticed or tempted to
  use tobacco or tobacco products such as vape pens, etc. Persons under 21 years
  of age shall be accompanied by a parent or guardian. Proof of valid ID for parent or
  guardian required. Proof of signage posted by the applicant (photo) should be
  submitted to Finance for verification. NO sales or use of marijuana or any cannabis
  products, any narcotics or narcotic paraphernalia, ie, any pipes used to ingest other
  narcotics such as base / "crack" cocaine, methamphetamine, etc. This would also
  include any glass cylindrical, tube, or bubble-shaped pipes used to smoke/ingest
  narcotics. Tobacco pipes are OK.****Sales or display of ANY weapons (ie; clubs,
  swords, knives, pepper spray, taser/stun guns, etc), Co2 cannisters aka: "whippits",
  sales-possession of any "Kratom" products are STRICTLY PROHIBITED!**NOTE:
  ALL initial AND renewal tobacco/hookah applicants or their designees are subject to
  random permit & licensing establishment inspections at ANYTIME of the day or
  night, by any police or code enforcement officer(s). The purpose of the random
  inspections is to ensure that the listed tobacco licensees comply with the laws &
  regulations set forth by the State of California Department of Tax & Fee
  Administration (CDTFA) and the City of Inglewood. Regular-Reasonable hours of
  operation shall be in place in or around a residential zone or area.*UNAUTHORIZED
  / NON-PERMITTED PARTIES, EVENTS, OR GATHERINGS ARE PROHIBITED.
  NO MUSIC BOXES, NO LIVE BANDS / MUSIC, DISC JOCKEYS (DJS), ETC.,
  SEPARATE PERMIT REQUIRED. APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE
  BUSINESS HOURS OF OPERATION IN OR AROUND RESIDENTIAL AREAS.
  Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the suspension and or
  revocation of the licensee's tobacco license. *** Adhere to all local, state, and federal
  laws; Code enforcement Department Condtions: Not sale, offer, provide and or
  provide and or furnish cannabis or base products. Subject to inspection by any Code
  Enforcement or Police Officer; No conditions needed for Fire approval. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426981)

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
Finance\Committee\P&L Agenda Special Meeting 4.30.26
